profile.headline: Software Architect & Tech Leader | Enterprise System Design | .NET Core & Angular | AI & Cloud Architecture
profile.summary:
I'm passionate about making change in lives and organizations. I currently do so by architecting scalable, high-performance software solutions that drive business impact.  With a strong foundation in full-stack development and enterprise architecture, I specialize in modernizing legacy systems, optimizing performance, and implementing scalable cloud-based solutions. 

Currently, I am leading the architectural transformation of a homegrown ERP/CRM system into a modern API-driven, cloud-ready platform using .NET Core, Angular, and Clean Architecture. My leadership in system design, performance optimization, and API strategy has resulted in:
- A 2% increase in top-line revenue through single-page checkout implementation.
- A 5x improvement in site performance and SEO rankings through strategic optimizations.
- 90% reduction in database query load, enhancing system scalability.
- Standardization of CI/CD and deployment strategies, achieving >99.99% uptime over 4+ years.

Before transitioning to software development, I spent 6 years as a high school physics, math, and technology teacher, leading curriculum modernization, robotics programs, and initiatives that increased student engagement by 50% in a single year. I raised $25,000 in external grants over two years to start a FIRST Robotics team, which won the prestigious Rookie All-Star award for school and community outreach and positive effect on school curriculum. Every physics student I taught passed the ACT Quality Core End-of-Course Exam. I am an internationally published physics author and effective presenter, receiving four winning research presentation awards as I presented at over 12 conferences during graduate school. 

My background in education, research, and leadership allows me to mentor and guide engineering teams effectively, fostering collaboration between technology and business. I'm excited to connect with fellow technologists, architects, and industry leaders to build future-ready software solutions.

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
•	Three-time recipient of company-wide "Clear Vision" award (2022, 2024, 2025)
•	Architected and led the modernization of an internal ERP/CRM into a scalable Angular and .NET Core system using Clean Architecture. While this is an ongoing project, completed sections have 70-90% reduced code complexity, improved maintainability, and increased uptime.
•	Defined the technical vision and led the team to complete implementation of single-page checkout, increasing UX resulting in an increase to company top-line revenue by an estimated 2% per year.
•	Led implementation of the launch of a new brand, SpinKids, representing ~1.4% of 2024 order volume.
•	Optimized critical database queries, reducing resource consumption by up to 90%.
•	Led the execution of a redesign of the main customer facing ecommerce site, improving performance and user experience.
•	Spearheaded SEO and site performance enhancements, resulting in 5x improvement in Google Search Console score, including reducing Cumulative Layout Shift to negligible amounts.
•	Replaced jpg/png images with next generation WEBP images, resulting in 90% less image payload, improved load times and customer experience.
•	Implemented IIS brotli / gzip compression, reducing document payload by 60%.
•	Guided architecture and assisted in implementation of customer-facing AI-based product search.
•	Consolidated work ticketing systems to a unified Azure DevOps system, improving cross-team collaboration. Developed a custom blue-green deployment tool, achieving over 99.9% uptime for 4+ years, even during deployments. Implemented peer-review system and reorganized requirements gathering process to reduce rework and technical debt. Constructed and modified several CI/CD pipelines.
•	Provided peer support and technical mentorship to two stateside developers and an india-based team.
•	Directed multiple cross-departmental data cleanup initiatives. Added safeguards to maintain future data integrity.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Angular · SQL · Business Analysis · Solution Architecture

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
•	Co-architected an Angular 8 app with a C# API backend for a customer creating best management plans for the disposal of fats, oils, and grease generated in food service establishments.
•	Led team to deliver 55k contract in under half the allotted time, resulting in a 70% margin.
•	Co-architected an Angular 8 app with a C# API backend for a customer creating best management plans for the disposal of fats, oils, and grease generated in food service establishments.
•	Developed a heuristic optimization model using to help a tree service more effectively dispatch by imposing a color wheel on the outer-belt-freeway of Columbus streamline dispatch logistics
•	Wrote Linux bash scripts to automate nightly data migration in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and the file system.
•	Wrote SQL scripts for a factory to inventory its parts. Interfaced with RFGen Scanners in Visual Basic to allow plant workers to move parts lots in First-in, First-out fashion.
•	Created mobile-friendly Bootstrap-based front end to interface with an existing ColdFusion backend.
•	Wrote an API and accompanying technical documentation for external access to system data.
•	Contributed to the development effort for a company helping socioeconomically disadvantaged students achieve their dreams of attending college.
•	Wrote a module in C# and AngularJS onto an existing application for a user to import Excel spreadsheets into a database to consolidate work into existing application structure. This avoided a great deal of duplicated work and provided reporting capability where not present because of the Excel work done outside the application structure.
•	Modified an existing Java program to allow client to more prominently display amended charges.
•	Rewrote business rules and provided enhancements in a C# and AngularJs application to satisfy changes to an application that exports ingredient data to an international synchronization database.

positions.title: Technology Teacher
positions.description:
•	Pioneered new AP Computer Science course
•	Taught Robotics, 3D Video Game Design, 3D Printing, iMovie, Photoshop, Arduino Electronics, Creative Essentials, Carduino Maker Class, Math 6 and Math 8.
•	Head Robotics Coach for our school's FTC and two FLL teams.
•	Created and published middle school student game 'Marburn Capture the Flag,' a 3D MMO including AI, on iOS, Mac, and Android app stores. Used 3D scanners to create playable characters from real world people, including the kinematic modeling.
•	Guided students to create modern cross-OS phone apps to control Arduino powered cars (JavaScript), including fabrication of custom car chassis using 3D printers and conventional fabrication
•	Created spreadsheet to enter and display standards-based grades and class data, including automatically generated grade comments, including color-coded instructions for teachers (Google Apps Script)
•	Self-taught MVC paradigm in preparation for pilot program with Apple Development (Swift)
•	Used a Myo armband to gather data and model the number of students arriving at school vs. time, which we analyzed as real-world data in algebra class (C++)

positions.title: Physics & Technology Teacher
positions.description:
•	Taught Physics, AP Computer Science, Web Tech, Robotics, Video Broadcasting, Architecture.
•	FRC robotics team won Rookie All-Star award; placed 31st in division in world championship.
•	Every student I taught passed the ACT Quality Core physics exam.
•	Raised over $25,000 of funding in grants and donations for our robotics team over two years.
•	Increased enrollment in tech courses offered this year by 50% from previous year.
•	Directed an outreach at the Public Library for elementary students and community members; our team was invited to help out with the science-based summer reading program for an entire week this year.
•	Directed outreach to Middle School students including a whole-school assembly, visits to 8th grade classrooms, and a visit to the elementary STEM club to encourage younger to take more math and science classes at a critical juncture in their development.
•	Modernized /created a curriculum for Architectural Drawing, Web Technologies, and Global Technologies to replace 10+ year outdated curriculum.
•	Guided robotics team to create an optimized vision/targeting system on a PandaBoard with an Xbox Kinect using OpenCV libraries (Python/Ubuntu)
•	Automated school announcements system to pull weather reports, create teleprompter scripts, and generate PowerPoint slides for TV displays (Auto Hotkey, Java, and Visual Basic) 
•	Created physics simulation applet to replace difficult-to-find lab equipment (Java)
•	Repaired and programmed CNC machine to allow students to fabricate prototypes they designed in CAD
•	Introduced 3D printing to the school and the robotics program

•	One section of physics, three sections of geometry, and one remedial Algebra II course.
